info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List Private Networks API
Attach a Load Balancer to a Private Network

params.name: zone
params.description: The zone you want to target

params.name: lb_id
params.description: Load Balancer ID.

items.docs: Attach a specified Load Balancer to a specified Private Network, defining a static or DHCP configuration for the Load Balancer on the network.

info.name: Detach Load Balancer from Private Network

params.name: zone
params.description: The zone you want to target

params.name: lb_id
params.description: Load balancer ID.

items.docs: Detach a specified Load Balancer from a specified Private Network.

info.name: List Private Networks attached to a Load Balancer

params.name: zone
params.description: The zone you want to target

params.name: lb_id
params.description: Load Balancer ID.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order of Private Network objects in the response.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of objects to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to return, from the paginated results.

items.docs: List the Private Networks attached to a given Load Balancer, specified by its Load Balancer ID. The response is an array of Private Network objects, giving information including the status, configuration, name and creation date of each Private Network.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order of the returned Private Networks.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to return, from the paginated results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of Private Networks to return per page.

params.name: name
params.description: Name to filter for. Only Private Networks with names containing this string will be returned.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to filter for. Only Private Networks with one or more matching tags will be returned.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Organization ID to filter for. Only Private Networks belonging to this Organization will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project ID to filter for. Only Private Networks belonging to this Project will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: private_network_ids
params.description: Private Network IDs to filter for. Only Private Networks with one of these IDs will be returned.

params.name: vpc_id
params.description: VPC ID to filter for. Only Private Networks belonging to this VPC will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: dhcp_enabled
params.description: DHCP status to filter for. When true, only Private Networks with managed DHCP enabled will be returned.

items.docs: List existing Private Networks in the specified region. By default, the Private Networks returned in the list are ordered by creation date in ascending order, though this can be modified via the order_by field.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

items.docs: Create a new Private Network. Once created, you can attach Scaleway resources which are in the same region.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: private_network_id
params.description: Private Network ID. (UUID format)

items.docs: Retrieve information about an existing Private Network, specified by its Private Network ID. Its full details are returned in the response object.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: private_network_id
params.description: Private Network ID. (UUID format)

items.docs: Update parameters (such as name or tags) of an existing Private Network, specified by its Private Network ID.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: private_network_id
params.description: Private Network ID. (UUID format)

items.docs: Delete an existing Private Network. Note that you must first detach all resources from the network, in order to delete it.

info.name: Enable DHCP on a Private Network

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: private_network_id
params.description: Private Network ID. (UUID format)

items.docs: Enable DHCP managed on an existing Private Network. Note that you will not be able to deactivate it afterwards.
